payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

supports.question: Does the image show a basketball playing surface as part of the background?
supports.criteria: Pass if a recognizable basketball playing surface is visible in the background; fail if the background is visibly not a basketball playing surface; unknown if the background or its surface cannot be assessed.
supports.binding: Assess the background relative to the input image and requested replacement. A visible playing surface is evidence toward the requested basketball-court background, not by itself proof that the full change is complete.

supports.question: Does the background show recognizable basketball-court markings or basketball equipment?
supports.criteria: Pass if recognizable court markings or basketball equipment are visible in the background; fail if neither is visible despite an assessable background; unknown if the background cannot be assessed.
supports.binding: Look for court markings or basketball equipment in the background as evidence that it is a basketball court. This evidence does not alone establish complete fulfillment.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Judge only the requested background change, using both supports and the original image as context. Complete (yes) if the background is visibly a basketball court, supported by a recognizable playing surface and court markings or basketball equipment. Partial if some requested progress is visible but the background is not yet recognizably a basketball court; either support may provide evidence of such progress, but neither alone guarantees it. Absent (no) if there is no visible progress toward a basketball-court background. Unknown if the evidence is insufficient to determine whether any requested progress occurred; required unknown evidence remains unresolved. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
